claim: If an item is still in the DAX item cache and someone else updates it directly in DynamoDB, bypassing DAX, DAX and DynamoDB hold inconsistent values for the same key until the TTL for the DAX item expires. An application that modifies data in the table and bypasses DAX needs to anticipate and tolerate these inconsistencies.

qualifiers.condition: the item is in the DAX item cache when it is updated directly in DynamoDB

evidence.quote: In this scenario, DAX and DynamoDB hold inconsistent values for the same key until the TTL for the DAX item expires.
If an application modifies data in an underlying DynamoDB table, bypassing DAX, the application needs to anticipate and tolerate data inconsistencies that might arise.
